rules.reason: Workflow, suite map, classifier and gate changes are merge-policy changes; they always run every suite.

Markdown, so validate-portable's link check reads it; scripts/test-build-metadata.py (validate-contracts, macOS-only because it runs /usr/bin/plutil) also checks the workflow's command lists, triggers and gate against it.
The global demo-guide distribution contract in scripts/test-delivery-proof.py reads both manual install commands. Markdown policy-link checks also apply.

Markdown outside the bundled skills and scripts. check-skill-overrides.mjs checks policy-anchor links in every tracked Markdown file, so validate-portable applies. No Xcode resource, build phase, test.sh input, guide probe input or validate-contracts suite reads these files; contract-read documentation matches merge-policy-doc or global-guide-install-docs first.
Documentation images. No build input, bundled resource, test or CI suite reads them.

Design evidence and prototypes under docs/. Not bundled or read by native tests, the guide probe or any validate-contracts suite. validate-portable still runs, conservatively, in case the Markdown checks read a file whose name the markdown-docs rule does not match.
Leaf test files that only validate-contracts runs. Nothing bundles, builds, imports or hashes them; the code they test is unmapped and selects every suite.
Leaf test file that only validate-portable runs. Nothing bundles, builds, imports or hashes it; the checker it tests is unmapped and selects every suite.
